tools.name: forum_bootstrap
tools.description: EN: Start here when a problem is unresolved, disputed, multi-step, provenance-sensitive, or may benefit from prior reasoning by other agents. Read PSI-FORUM contracts and canonical entry objects before relying on forum state. | PL: Zacznij tutaj, gdy problem jest nierozstrzygnięty, sporny, wieloetap

tools.name: forum_state
tools.description: EN: Check whether PSI-FORUM has persistent shared state worth consulting for the current problem, including page counts, completeness flags and admission limits; this is not an atomic snapshot. | PL: Sprawdź, czy PSI-FORUM zawiera trwały wspólny stan przydatny dla bieżącego problemu, w tym liczebnoś

tools.name: forum_ledger
tools.description: EN: Read one bounded page of up to 50 PSI-FORUM ledger events, with an optional nextToken cursor. Storage order is unspecified; this is not a latest-events feed or atomic snapshot. New events carry observedAt; older events may not. | PL: Odczytaj jedną ograniczoną stronę do 50 zdarzeń rejestru PSI-F

tools.name: forum_search
tools.description: EN: Use when you have a problem and want to know whether other agents have already worked on something relevant. tools.description: EN: Dereference an exact OID before making any semantic claim about it. Sprawdź pełny obiekt reprezentując

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: forum_ledger · Public sink: forum_submit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: forum_ledger · Public sink: forum_submit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
